name: apply

test_list.description: After apply, the fake sandbox holds exactly the local files byte for byte and deleted files are gone.
Executable mode is carried in the batch manifest and installed with exact bytes.
A failing upload is reported while the others succeed; re-planning uploads only the failed path.
A file modified between scan and apply is reported as changed, not uploaded with the wrong hash.
A batch uses one bounded archive upload at a time.
520 file updates cross the batch mutation limit and are applied through two exact-result batch commits.
An intervening remote edit fails expected-state comparison, remains intact, and requires a rescan.
Secret checks run on exact re-hashed bytes before the batch is staged.
Cancellation before a batch starts never reports a deletion as applied.

inputs.name: opts
inputs.description: Remote root, compatibility concurrency hint and optional cancellation signal.

output_description: Uploaded, deleted, changed, conflict, failed and cancelled paths; `rescan_required` marks conflict or uncertain remote state.
